EmailTemplate.subject: Upcoming Blood Drive Information - Blood Type O
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear [Insert Name], I would like to share some information with you about type O blood and the impact your upcoming blood drive can make. While all blood types are needed; blood types O negative and O positive must be collected at a higher rate to keep up with hospital demand. In emergency situations when there’s no time to determine a patient’s blood type, doctors reach for type O blood. These critical blood types are always in high demand but often in low supply. It’s important for you to know that the recruitment actions you take as a blood program leader can directly impact our ability to respond to hospital demand.
Next Steps, immediately review the attached items:
Info piece - what you should know before your drive and easy ways to increase your impact. Donor email - a template you can customize and use to recruit eligible type O blood donors.
Additional tips for success:
Before the blood drive, make a personal call to type O donors, reminding them why their appointment is needed and thank them for scheduling an appointment to give blood. If a Power Red device is assigned to the blood drive, ensure the type O donor is educated on the process and, if eligible, is encouraged to donate Power Red.
Thank you again for your commitment as a blood program leader. I am confident that with some additional efforts, you will increase your type O donors. If you have any questions, please do not hesitate to reach out – I’m always here to help! All the best, [Insert Name]
